title: Learning from Failure
paragraphs: After his small catering business failed within its first year, Bashir felt embarrassed to discuss it with friends who had invested their savings alongside him in the venture.
Rather than avoiding the topic entirely, he spent several weeks carefully analyzing what had gone wrong, from pricing mistakes to poor supplier choices he had made without enough research.

A year later, he launched a second, smaller business with a clearer plan, directly applying the specific lessons from his earlier failure instead of simply hoping the outcome would be different this time.
This second venture succeeded modestly but steadily, and Bashir often tells younger entrepreneurs that his first failure taught him far more than any success could have taught him alone.
